topic: Kakashi keeps his transplanted Sharingan covered because a non-Uchiha cannot switch it off and pays chakra for every second
title: The Real Reason Kakashi Kept His Eye Covered
description: Kakashi keeps his Sharingan covered for a reason most fans skip: as a non-Uchiha he can't turn it off, and it drains him constantly. Chapters 16, 459 and 12 explain the price. Which side do you take?
comment: Is Kakashi's covered eye the price of Obito's gift, or proof he's the stronger Sharingan user? Pick one.

lines.text: Kakashi covers his Sharingan for a reason nobody talks about.

shot.fallback: masked ninja with a headband over his left eye

lines.text: It isn't style. It's a chakra bill.
Obito's eye came with a catch for anyone who isn't an Uchiha.

shot.fallback: boy with goggles holding out his hand

lines.text: It never switches off. Chapter 459 spells that out.

shot.fallback: one red eye glowing under a headband

lines.text: A real Uchiha keeps a Sharingan running on almost nothing.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with calm red eyes

lines.text: Kakashi burns chakra just by opening that left eye.

shot.fallback: masked ninja lifting a headband to show a red eye

lines.text: That's why chapter 16 shows him uncovering it only when Zabuza forces his hand.

shot.search: Kakashi Zabuza Sharingan Land of Waves
shot.fallback: masked ninja facing a swordsman in the mist

lines.text: Use it long and he's bedridden for days.

shot.fallback: silver haired ninja resting in a hospital bed

lines.text: After the Gaara rescue, Guy actually has to carry him out on his back.

shot.fallback: muscular ninja carrying a tired friend on his back

lines.text: People say that's just Obito's eye being too strong.

shot.fallback: scarred man with a spiral eye

lines.text: But a transplant doesn't explain who pays for it. That's always Kakashi, never Obito.

shot.fallback: tired ninja covering his eye with one hand

lines.text: And he still became the Copy Ninja with it, chapter 12, over a thousand techniques.

shot.fallback: silver haired ninja mirroring a jutsu

lines.text: So who really owns an eye that one man gave and the other man pays for?

shot.fallback: two boys and a girl standing together

lines.text: So every time that headband slides down, here's what it hides:

shot.fallback: masked ninja sliding a headband off one eye

self_check.hook: Hidden-detail hook in line 1 about the covered eye.
